repo.description:
### Impact
`qc_info` plugin implements `information_schema.query_cache_info` table that shows the content of the MariaDB query cache. A query with embedded zero bytes can trick it into reading beyond the end of the heap-allocated buffer.

### Patches
Fixed in 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, 13.0.2.

### Workarounds
Uninstall `qc_info` plugin.

### References
https://jira.mariadb.org/browse/MDEV-40670

### Credits
Reported by [Yuelin Wang](mailto:violin0613@tju.edu.cn)
